$comment: Central registry of all written-text corpus sources across the Sauti Labs platform. Each entry must conform to frameworks/corpus-registry/schema/corpus-source.schema.json. Tracks provenance and copyright status distinct from dataset-framework's processed dataset registry.

sources.title: Muma Manyien - Dholuo Bible Translation
sources.license_details: Publisher and permission terms not yet formally verified by Sauti Labs; must be confirmed directly with the Bible Society of Kenya before use in any dataset.
sources.notes: Identified as a candidate source due to high translation quality and full-text coverage in Dholuo, a severely under-resourced language. Status intentionally set to 'unknown_pending_review' and copyright_status left unresolved per corpus-registry's Copyright Discipline rule — must not be used to derive any dataset until formally cleared.
